messages:
Lena (CS): NovaFleet opened a ticket: they want a delay-reason classifier + short, auditable explanation for driver exceptions. They emphasized no customer PII in outputs and a clear audit trail for their procurement review.
NovaFleet-CS: Yep, procurement wants this in the renewal packet. Primary data includes driver notes and OCR'd POD images (we can share a small redacted sample).
Carlos - Solutions Eng: Thanks. Do we have the sample dataset link?
NovaFleet-CS: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/uploads/nf-delay-sample-2026.csv (redacted), and a 50-image set in S3 (read-only).
Priya (Applied ML): Quick peek: the notes have location names and sometimes license plates (OCR). We should run a PII scrub and add an image redaction step for the OCR pipeline.
Nadia (Compliance): Strongly agree. Also add consent metadata check per their contract (section 2.1) — need provenance for any images used in evals.
Lena (CS): Customer wants a demo before their renewal review on 2026-06-10. That gives ~7 weeks. They asked specifically for: 1) baseline metrics (F1 by class), 2) sample audit log showing inputs, model decision, and which rule triggered masking, 3) deployment options (Dedicated vs Private).
Carlos - Solutions Eng: Feasible timeline if we scope it: evaluation + masked-demo on Dedicated. Private pilot would likely add 2-3 weeks for network setup.
Priya (Applied ML): Proposal: train a small classifier on redwood/7b-classic-quant with a post-hoc explanation head (LIME-style summaries limited to non-PII tokens). Eval plan: 3k annotated rows, holdout by driver, measure macro-F1 + explanation faithfulness.
Nadia (Compliance): Explanations must be deterministic for auditability. If we use LIME, document random seed & store explanation vectors in audit log. Also need KMS for model artifact signing.
Carlos - Solutions Eng: Noted. For Dedicated demo, we can enable audit-log export and redact fields at ingestion. We'll need a short runbook for the customer demo explaining data handling.
Lena (CS): Action items: Carlos -> demo scope + infra checklist; Priya -> eval manifest + PII redaction plan; Nadia -> compliance note + artifact signing checklist; Lena -> renewal risk blurb for AM.
deploy-bot: Canary reminder: any model that touches images must pass the image-safety gate and the external PII-scan before routing traffic.
Priya (Applied ML): Will add an image redaction step using the image-PII detector and store both original (encrypted) and redacted in separate buckets for auditing.
NovaFleet-CS: We cannot expose original images in the demo; redacted-only is fine. Procurement needs confirmation that originals remain encrypted and only accessible under incident request.
Nadia (Compliance): We will include that in the customer-facing compliance sheet. Also require retention window for audit logs (default 365 days) — confirm if they need longer.
Lena (CS): I'll ask NovaFleet about retention. For now assume 365d and flag if they request changes.
Carlos - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare a demo plan that uses a masked sample and includes an exported audit CSV with explanation tokens, model score, and masking tags. ETA for draft: 3 business days.
Priya (Applied ML): ETA for initial eval harness + manifest: EOD Friday. I'll include a small quality check notebook and baseline metrics.
Nadia (Compliance): I'll draft the compliance addendum and artifact signing checklist; aiming for 4 business days.
Lena (CS): Thanks all. Scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow 9am PT to align. @NovaFleet-CS we'll invite your technical PM. :calendar:
